fields.title: Lemon Rice
fields.description: A bright, quick rice dish with lemon, herbs, and a little crunch.
fields.ingredients:
2 cups cooked rice
1 lemon, juiced
1 tablespoon oil
1 teaspoon mustard seeds
8 curry leaves
1/4 cup roasted peanuts
Salt to taste
fields.notes: Use day-old rice if you have it. It keeps the grains separate.

fields.title: Tomato Soup
fields.description: A simple tomato soup for showing basic recipe records in the demo app.
fields.ingredients:
6 ripe tomatoes
1 small onion
2 cloves garlic
2 cups vegetable stock
1 tablespoon olive oil
Salt and pepper
fields.notes: Blend until smooth and serve with toast.

fields.title: Masala Omelette
fields.description: A fast breakfast omelette with onion, chili, cilantro, and warm spices.
fields.ingredients:
2 eggs
2 tablespoons chopped onion
1 green chili, chopped
1 tablespoon cilantro
1 pinch turmeric
Salt to taste
fields.notes: Cook on medium heat so the eggs stay tender.

fields.title: Garlic Butter Pasta
fields.description: A tiny pantry pasta recipe that works well as demo content.
fields.ingredients:
200g pasta
2 tablespoons butter
3 cloves garlic, minced
1/4 cup pasta water
2 tablespoons grated cheese
Black pepper
fields.notes: Save pasta water before draining; it helps make the sauce glossy.

fields.title: Cucumber Mint Salad
fields.description: A cool, crisp salad for balancing richer dishes.
fields.ingredients:
1 cucumber, sliced
1/2 cup yogurt
1 tablespoon chopped mint
1 teaspoon lemon juice
Salt to taste
